branch.new_demand: Prove that the construction yields a square, and use the proof to compute.

questions.skill: Justify that the inscribed quadrilateral is a square
questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: Diameters AC and BD of a circle with center O are perpendicular. Prove that ABCD is a square.
questions.prompt_markup: Diameters AC and BD of a circle with center O are perpendicular. Prove that ABCD is a square.
questions.required_method: Use that the diagonals are congruent (both diameters), bisect each other (radii), and are perpendicular; or SAS on the four triangles.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof. Essential: OA = OB = OC = OD; four right angles at O; SAS gives four congruent sides; each triangle is isosceles right, so each vertex angle is 45° + 45° = 90°.
